findings.finding: VirtualFree failure discarded the owning allocation address and reported cleanup completion
findings.resolution: Added Error::Free, retained pointer and Fault state after failed free, explicit unpublished retry, real successful free on retry

findings.finding: No tests reached partial RtlAddFunctionTable rollback or failed RtlDeleteFunctionTable retention
findings.resolution: Injected exactly one API refusal per configured stage; all other Add/Delete/Free calls use real Windows APIs; tested Add failure at stages 0..4, Delete failure at each table, combined Add/Delete failure and free-only cleanup retry

findings.finding: Batch methods had no explicit concurrency or borrowed Entry/source-module lifetime contract
findings.resolution: Documented single serialized installer owner, Entry only borrowed before Bindings, original module/continuations retained and intact for every call, and no destructor teardown

reviewedMechanics: Each generated page carries a DWORD-relative RUNTIME_FUNCTION at +64, BeginAddress=0 and exact planner codeSize, UnwindData=32; per-page RtlAddFunctionTable BaseAddress matches page address
Entire five-body retail input is compared by the pure planner before each 80-byte image is copied; no source byte is patched by preparation
RX protection and cache flush precede registration; all five registrations must succeed before Prepared
Failed Delete retains every code/unwind/table byte in the whole allocation and every unresolved OS registration; successfully deleted registrations are not deleted again on retry
Failed VirtualFree after successful deletes retains exact pointer for retry without falsely retaining OS table registrations
Bindings seals before pointer assignment; ReleaseUnpublished never invokes Delete/Free after Bound; repeated Bindings returns identical pointers
Default Batch object destruction does not reclaim bound storage; actual Windows lookup and RX memory were tested after a temporary owner went out of scope
remainingLimits: Caller must serialize Batch methods; concurrent Bindings versus ReleaseUnpublished is not supported
Source module lifetime and byte integrity after Prepare remain installer responsibilities; this prerequisite does not independently prove hook installation or thread draining
Tests never execute copied KH2 instruction streams; earlier StatusEntryPlan tests supply the native unwind-behavior validation
